label: thm:qou-obstruction-reduction
title: Conditional on the Wigner axiom: the obstruction is the Euler characteristic of the base
html:
Theorem. Conditional on the Wigner axiom: the obstruction is the Euler characteristic of the base

Theorem (conditional on conj:wigner-axiom). Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with gauge group G = \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) of dimension d = \dim G, with archimedean base curve M_0, and assume the Wigner axiom: the classical limit obstruction \mathrm{Obs}(\mathbf{C}, q \to 1) (classical limit obstruction) is one-dimensional and spanned by a class w(A) whose image under the tower comparison is the Euler class e(\xi) \in H^2(M_0; \mathbb{Z}) of the tangent bundle of M_0. Then:

(a) The obstruction is determined by a single integer, the Euler characteristic of the base:

  \mathrm{Obs}(\mathbf{C}, q \to 1) \cong k, \qquad w(A) \longmapsto \langle e(\xi), [M_0] \rangle = \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = 2 - 2g(M_0).

(b) The obstruction vanishes at Kummer level n iff n \mid \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0).

What the axioms of a quantum observable universe supply towards the Wigner axiom, and what they do not, is recorded in the proof.
